description: Schema for supervised behavior cues used by ml_personality_pipeline behavior summaries

face_visibility.definition: How clearly and consistently the person is visible in the frame

smile_positive_expression.definition: Presence and intensity of a smile or other positive visible expression

face_centering.definition: How well the face is centered and kept in view within the frame

face_size.definition: How large and clearly visible the face appears in the frame

head_movement.definition: Amount of head motion or movement across sampled frames

audio_speaking_rhythm.definition: Speaking activity, pause pattern, and rhythm inferred from audio

normalization: Scores should be continuous in [0,1]. Use at least 3 independent human raters and average.
